bullets: Powerful Air Purification for Large Rooms: SwitchBot HEPA air purifier helps capture airborne particles such as smoke, dust, pet dander, and household odors. With a large grille pressurized intake design, it purifies a 433 sq. ft. bedroom in 7.2 minutes and covers up to 3,620 sq. ft. per hour, making it ideal for bedrooms, living rooms, offices, pet rooms, nurseries, basements, kitchens, and smoke-prone seasons caused by wildfires.
Full Smart Home Compatibility: One of the few smart air purifier that support Matter, allowing seamless native control via Alexa, Apple Home (Homkit), or Google Home. (Supports 2.4GHz WiFi, not 5GHz)

Odor Sensor for Everyday Smoke & Household Odors: Built with a high-sensitivity odor sensor and pet-focused filter, it automatically increases airflow when odors are detected. It helps reduce common household odors from cooking, smoke, pets, garbage, and sweat, with 98.18% of odors cleared within 30 minutes under test conditions.

Powerful Adsorption Force: The inlet features a 360° wide grid and accelerated design, providing greater air pressure and speed. This ensures better suction of floating pet hair and dust particles in the air. It’s the superior choice for air purifiers in pet households.

Captures Pet Hair Efficiently: Designed with a dedicated Pet Mode and a pet-focused filter, this pet air purifier works with a wide intake grille to capture up to 93.45% of airborne pet hair in just 30 minutes. It is recommended that pet owners use Pet Mode to help reduce airborne pet hair.
Washable Pre-filter: Cleaning the pre-filter with water can help extend the lifespan of a 3-stage filtration system. This means you don't need to purchase filters frequently, reducing money waste!

4-Color Air Quality Indicator & 10 RGB Light Colors: The air quality is clearly displayed with the 4-color air quality indicator. In addition, it serves as an RGB ambient light, offering 10 RGB color options, with adjustable brightness and color to suit your preferences. It is also equipped with a light sensor, so it will automatically turn off the lights at night and operate quietly.

Pet-friendly Design: This home air purifier is equipped with a leak-proof top tray, perfect for pets to sit or rest on. It includes a child lock to prevent accidents, a pet-safe grille that won’t trap paws, a detachable adapter, and a low-voltage, bite-resistant cord. Thanks to its thoughtful safety design, this air purifier is an ideal choice for homes with babies and pets.
Aromatherapy: Add essential oils to a diffuser pad to eliminate pet urine odors in your home and create a pleasant fragranced room.

Simple App Control: With the free SwitchBot app, you can easily power on/off, adjust fan speed, choose modes, check real-time air quality, set timers, schedule delayed shut-off, control lighting, enable light-sensing auto-off, adjust light color and brightness, and receive filter replacement reminders.
